item.title: Teleport Engineers Use LLMs to Pressure Wash Codebase
item.description:
Teleport Engineers Use LLMs to Pressure Wash Codebase

Thirteen engineers sponsored by Teleport spent 90 days “pressure washing” their codebase using Large Language Models (LLMs).

💡 Why it matters

  • Quality is more important than quantity for finding security vulnerabilities.

#LLM #Teleport #Codebase #Security
